observation.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
cd /tmp
rm -f final.txt
HTML=$(curl -s --max-time 60 -c final.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/)
CSRF=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -o "name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]*\"" | sed "s/.*content=\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/")
curl -s --max-time 60 -b final.txt -c final.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: $CSRF" \
  -d "{\"username\":\"admin@example.com\",\"password\":\"test\",\"fingerprint\":\"final-verify\"}" \
  -o /tmp/final_signin.json -w "FINAL_LOGIN_HTTP=%{http_code}\n"
grep -o "\"login\":\"[^\"]*\"\|\"email\":\"[^\"]*\"\|\"active\":[a-z]*" /tmp/final_signin.json | head -3
'
echo "=== ES ticket/search indexes ==="
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'curl -s http://elasticsearch:9200/_cat/indices?format=json 2>/dev/null | grep -o "\"zammad_development_[a-z_]*\"" | sort -u | head -30'
